Human metapneumovirus case update -

ICMR detects two cases of #HMPV) in Karnataka during routine surveillance.

• A 3-month-old female infant admitted with bronchopneumonia, now discharged.
• 8-month-old male infant tested positive, recovering.
• Karnataka Health Minister https://t.co/wIL1qlur6w
